study: Forestry and fisheries coverage in the Agriculture, Food and Veterinary Science pilot

design.roster: Eleven journals in the control. Add Frontiers in Forests and Global Change and Acta Ichthyologica et Piscatoria for thirteen, including the same two regional OAI publishers.
design.comparisons: Two independently collected weekly editions and an expanded 28-day edition on each reserved date. All six initial runs used the same relevance, grouping, ranking, English summary and three-paper minimum. Two additional cold 28-day runs separately tested corrected mathematical comparison signs with fresh model calls.
design.case_selection: Highest and lowest distinct monthly ranks citing an existing or new specialist forestry, fisheries or regional source, or classified in forestry or fisheries. If only one such rank existed, check it and also check the opposite end of the whole ranking. Check the largest fully reviewed excluded candidate containing a target paper. Order ties by paper IDs. Judge whether a defensible three-paper subset was missed.
design.frozen_comparison: Reproduced the original 28-day candidate groups using archived embeddings and the screened pool. Reclustering each of the four non-overlapping seven-day segments measures the effect on group formation before model review.
design.source_audit: Matched all catalogue DOIs, publication days and per-record XML before checking the dated store. Types for 63 eligible records comprised 54 original forestry articles, six fisheries research articles and three fisheries short communications. Article types and dates refer to the published version. Acceptance notices were counted separately.
design.abstract_comparison: Compared a normalized narrative abstract from publisher XML with parsed publisher deposits. Removed structured headings and layout for comparison and retained word characters and the orientation of comparison signs. All 63 eligible records matched. Per-record hashes under normalized_deposited_abstract_sha256 describe the earlier deposit normalization.
design.regional_dates: Read every article linked from the 2026 issues in the Uruguay and Peru publisher archives. Prefer the displayed article publication date, cross-checking structured dates and recording conflicts. Matched the DOI and displayed article date in each study window against the OAI intake.

original.headline: Microbial diversity and networks linked to soil multifunctionality in three field surveys (forest, restoration, alfalfa)
original.finding: Three observational soil studies related ecological functions to microbial community measures. Depth and elevation in one forest, alternative land uses after cropping, and fields of different alfalfa ages were separate comparisons. The synthesis kept their distinct designs and reported associations.

original.headline: Pot, basket and field trials test amendments and cropping to curb cadmium in edible crops
original.finding: Four studies tested how cultivation or soil management changed cadmium reaching edible tissues. The reported mushroom and wheat responses, potato comparison and remaining limit exceedance in the rotation study agreed with the original reports. The brief distinguished the crops and the longer text identified the scale of each trial.

Two papers addressed fish health. The other three studied markets, recovery of fishing livelihoods after a cyclone, or the spread of introduced fish. No three reported a comparable outcome on a single fisheries question.

original.headline: Feeding trials and a review test fishmeal and soybean meal substitutes in farmed fish
original.finding: The three feeding trials and a review all examined alternative protein ingredients. The headline described the review as testing replacements. It synthesized published studies. The longer text separated the review from the new trials. A scoped note identifies the study types.

original.headline: Rangeland image classifiers validated for juniper, pasture degradation and steppe cover
original.finding: The three studies assessed rangeland vegetation or condition in images. The synthesis said transfer to new landscapes was untested in every case. The Kazakhstan team tested on entirely held-out districts. The desert-steppe team held out source images from one site. A scoped note specifies this distinction.

The ten papers covered different image-analysis tasks. Three independently evaluated localization of visible crop damage in images. Two detected bounded symptomatic regions and one delineated lesion pixels. Their datasets and metrics differed, but a three-paper subset could have reported this shared task without combining performance scores.

after_source_text_fix.headline: Field surveys link soil multifunctionality to depth and microbial networks across land uses
after_source_text_fix.finding: The three studies tested related soil questions. The new synthesis described all of them as lacking replicated systems. The alfalfa study used three separate fields for each age and the restoration study used five plots for each land use. The English note distinguishes local replication from regional generalizability.

after_source_text_fix.headline: Genome-wide gene family scans with controlled stress expression assays in five crops
after_source_text_fix.finding: The five crop papers studied families of genes associated with environmental stress. The soybean study was the only one to test a gene effect on stress tolerance, but the statement that only soybean went beyond expression overlooked the rice study’s experimental check of protein location.

Two papers addressed fish health. The other three studied markets, recovery of fishing livelihoods after a cyclone, or the spread of introduced fish. No three reported a comparable outcome on a single fisheries question.

after_source_text_fix.headline: Feeding trials and a review test fishmeal and soybean meal substitutes in farmed fish
after_source_text_fix.finding: The three feeding trials and a review all examined alternative protein ingredients. The headline described the review as testing replacements. It synthesized published studies. The longer text separated the review from the new trials. A scoped note identifies the study types.

after_source_text_fix.headline: Cross-sectional household surveys link cassava, rice contracts, forest livelihoods to welfare
after_source_text_fix.finding: Three household surveys reported associations between participation in agricultural livelihoods and welfare. The English synthesis distinguished household expenditure in Nigeria, rice income in Ghana and the child welfare index in Hunan. It correctly described the observational designs, selection of the Hunan sample and additional household work reported for children.

The 13-paper group mixed different soil processes. Three experiments measured how changes in cropping or additions to soil affected phosphatase activity. The salt-affected maize and mine-reclamation experiments measured alkaline phosphatase. The forest-understory experiment measured acid phosphatase. A comparative group could identify the enzyme and study setting separately without pooling the values.

costs.billing_scope: Per-attempt model usage reconciled against the new pilot ledgers. Hosting fees are outside these measurements. Historical cold pilots do not estimate monthly recurring operation.

ranked_paper.headline: Logical-gate architectures and mediator-assisted control push toward fault tolerance

publication_decision.reason: Longer evidence windows produced additional topics and brought specialist work into some ranks. The sampled windows still favor one agronomy journal, neither regional source established a ranked contribution, and the small repeated editorial samples do not meet the independent high, low and excluded publication criterion.
publication_decision.budget: The service-wide monthly model budget will be decided from real pilot and operating measurements. Only November 19 and 20 currently have attributable costs for all three public editions.

regional_publication_languages.source: Compared the publication language on each publisher page with its OAI record and the selected title and abstract. All ten supplied an English title and abstract. One publisher page listed Spanish while the OAI feed listed English. The edition credits the source when displaying language metadata.
